architectureNow.summary: libghostty embedding uses ghostty_surface_t with GHOSTTY_PLATFORM_MACOS and an NSView. Metal is inside libghostty. Horca must host that view in Electron, not paint a CAMetalLayer and feed bytes to an unbound surface.

capabilities.capability: native Metal renderer via libghostty surface
capabilities.evidence: libghostty C API ghostty_surface_t; Ghostty macOS uses Metal; cmux embeds libghostty as the renderer.
capabilities.architectureImpact: PRIMARY macOS UI renderer. Electron must host NSView/CAMetalLayer owned by libghostty. Current orca_ghostty_macos_available()==false is an incomplete bridge.

capabilities.capability: native keyboard/IME via Ghostty key encoder and AppKit
capabilities.evidence: ghostty/vt/key.h; Ghostty macOS uses native text input. cmux is Swift/AppKit.
capabilities.architectureImpact: Do not recreate Ghostty key semantics in JS on the native path.
Native path should not bake glyphs in a JS canvas atlas.

capabilities.capability: libghostty-vt WASM parse/state for portable fallback
capabilities.evidence: Horca already ships libghostty-vt WASM for renderer and daemon.
Ghostty implements kitty keyboard protocol; libghostty-vt key encoder.
Ghostty parses kitty graphics. libghostty-vt render-state image export is still incomplete (ghostty-org/ghostty#12111).
capabilities.architectureImpact: Native surface can render images internally. WASM/WebGL fallback is BLOCKED_WITH_EVIDENCE until render-state exposes image data.

capabilities.evidence: Orca xterm linkifiers plus Ghostty OSC 8.
Ghostty supports OSC 52; Orca has its own clipboard policy that must be preserved.

capabilities.capability: shell integration (cwd, prompt marks, semantic prompt)
capabilities.evidence: Ghostty shell-integration. Not an xterm.js feature.
libghostty-vt can parse tmux control mode; Horca product uses pane splits, not tmux control mode as UI.
cmux does this. Horca owns appearance through Orca settings; silently reading Ghostty config would bypass product settings.
cmux is a native Swift/AppKit app, not Electron. Horca is Electron. The spike must host libghostty inside Electron, not replace the app shell.
Ghostty-the-app feature. Not required for Orca xterm parity.
ghostty_inspector_t is a Ghostty developer tool, not a Horca product surface.
libghostty-vt Unicode; Orca had CJK/wide-char tests.
